concepts.zh: 站在平面镜前，镜中的像是怎样的？
concepts.en: You stand in front of a plane mirror. What is your image like?
concepts.whyZh: 平面镜成正立、等大、与物体关于镜面对称的虚像。
concepts.whyEn: A plane mirror forms an upright, same-size virtual image, symmetric to the object about the mirror.

concepts.zh: 汽车突然刹车，乘客身体向前倾，原因是？
concepts.en: A car brakes suddenly and passengers lurch forward. Why?
concepts.answerZh: 乘客具有惯性，要保持原来的运动状态
concepts.answerEn: Passengers have inertia and tend to keep moving
wrongZh: 汽车给乘客一个向前的推力
乘客受到一个向前的“惯性力”
concepts.whyZh: 惯性是物体保持原有运动状态的性质，不是一种力。
concepts.whyEn: Inertia is the tendency to keep the current motion. It is a property, not a force.

concepts.zh: 声音不能在下列哪种环境中传播？
concepts.en: In which of these can sound NOT travel?
concepts.whyZh: 声音靠介质振动传播，真空中没有介质。
concepts.whyEn: Sound travels by vibrating a medium, and a vacuum has none.

concepts.zh: 用热水袋暖手，热量主要通过什么方式传递？
concepts.en: You warm your hands on a hot-water bottle. How does the heat mainly travel?
concepts.whyZh: 手与热水袋直接接触，热量沿接触面由高温处传向低温处。
concepts.whyEn: Your hand touches the bottle, so heat flows directly across the contact surface.

concepts.zh: 家庭电路中的各用电器通常是怎样连接的？
concepts.en: How are the appliances in a household circuit normally connected?
wrongEn: Half in series, half in parallel
It depends on how many there are
concepts.whyZh: 并联时各用电器两端电压相同且互不影响。
concepts.whyEn: In parallel every appliance gets the same voltage and works independently.

concepts.zh: 一块冰漂浮在水面上，它受到的浮力？
concepts.en: An ice cube floats on water. The buoyant force on it is…
concepts.whyZh: 漂浮时处于平衡状态，浮力与重力大小相等。
concepts.whyEn: Floating means equilibrium, so buoyancy equals weight.

concepts.zh: 下列哪种做法是为了增大摩擦？
concepts.en: Which of these is done to INCREASE friction?
concepts.answerEn: Cutting a tread into shoe soles
wrongZh: 气垫船向下喷气使船身脱离水面
wrongEn: A hovercraft lifting its hull on air
concepts.whyZh: 花纹增大接触面的粗糙程度；其余三项都是在减小摩擦。
concepts.whyEn: Treads roughen the surface. The other three all reduce friction.

concepts.zh: 在标准大气压下，水沸腾时它的温度？
concepts.en: At standard atmospheric pressure, what happens to the temperature of boiling water?
concepts.answerZh: 保持不变，但仍要持续吸热
concepts.answerEn: Stays constant, but it keeps absorbing heat
concepts.whyZh: 沸腾吸收的热量用于汽化，温度保持在沸点。
concepts.whyEn: The heat goes into vaporising the water, so the temperature stays at the boiling point.

concepts.zh: 物体静置在水平桌面上，下列哪一对力是相互作用力？
concepts.en: A book rests on a table. Which pair of forces is an action–reaction pair?
concepts.answerZh: 物体对桌面的压力与桌面对物体的支持力
concepts.answerEn: The book’s push on the table and the table’s support force
wrongZh: 物体的重力与桌面对物体的支持力
物体的重力与物体对桌面的压力
桌面对物体的支持力与桌面受到的重力
wrongEn: The book’s weight and the table’s support force
The book’s weight and the book’s push on the table
The table’s support force and the table’s weight
concepts.whyZh: 相互作用力作用在两个不同物体上、性质相同；重力与支持力作用在同一物体上，是一对平衡力。
concepts.whyEn: Action–reaction forces act on different bodies and are of the same kind; weight and support act on one body and balance.

concepts.zh: 在真空中，羽毛与铁球从同一高度同时由静止释放，结果？
concepts.en: In a vacuum a feather and an iron ball are released together from the same height. What happens?
concepts.whyZh: 只受重力时加速度都是 g，与质量无关。
concepts.whyEn: With gravity alone both accelerate at g, regardless of mass.

concepts.zh: 匀速圆周运动中，向心加速度的方向？
concepts.en: In uniform circular motion, the centripetal acceleration points…
concepts.whyZh: 向心加速度只改变速度的方向，所以垂直于速度并指向圆心。
concepts.whyEn: It only changes the direction of the velocity, so it is perpendicular to it and points to the centre.

concepts.zh: 闭合线圈中的磁通量增加时，楞次定律指出感应电流的磁场？
concepts.en: When the magnetic flux through a closed loop increases, Lenz’s law says the induced field…
wrongEn: Always points the same way as the original field
Always points opposite to the original field
concepts.whyZh: “阻碍变化”不等于“方向相反”：磁通量减小时，感应磁场与原磁场同向。
concepts.whyEn: “Opposes the change” is not “opposite direction”: when flux decreases, the induced field points the same way.

concepts.zh: 能否发生光电效应，取决于入射光的什么？
concepts.en: Whether the photoelectric effect occurs depends on the light’s…
concepts.whyZh: 光子能量 hf 必须大于金属的逸出功，与光强和照射时间无关。
concepts.whyEn: The photon energy hf must exceed the work function; intensity and time do not matter.

concepts.zh: 两小球在光滑水平面上碰撞，系统不受外力，则一定守恒的是？
concepts.en: Two balls collide on a frictionless surface with no external force. What is always conserved?
concepts.whyZh: 系统合外力为零时动量守恒；非弹性碰撞中动能不守恒。
concepts.whyEn: Momentum is conserved when the net external force is zero; kinetic energy is lost in inelastic collisions.

concepts.zh: 理想变压器原线圈 100 匝、副线圈 50 匝，原线圈输入 220 V，副线圈电压是？
concepts.en: An ideal transformer has 100 primary and 50 secondary turns. With 220 V on the primary, the secondary voltage is…

concepts.zh: 一定质量的理想气体等温压缩，其压强？
concepts.en: An ideal gas is compressed isothermally. Its pressure…
concepts.whyZh: 等温时 pV 为常数，体积减小则压强增大。
concepts.whyEn: At constant temperature pV is constant, so smaller volume means higher pressure.

concepts.zh: 狭义相对论中，相对观察者高速运动的时钟？
concepts.en: In special relativity, a clock moving fast relative to an observer…
concepts.whyZh: 运动时钟的时间间隔被拉长，因子为洛伦兹因子 γ。
concepts.whyEn: The moving clock’s intervals are stretched by the Lorentz factor γ.

concepts.zh: 海森堡不确定性原理指出？
concepts.en: The Heisenberg uncertainty principle says…
concepts.answerZh: 不能同时任意精确地确定粒子的位置和动量
concepts.answerEn: Position and momentum cannot both be known with arbitrary precision
wrongZh: 粒子的能量必须是整数倍
粒子的位置永远无法被测量
测量会必然改变粒子的质量
wrongEn: A particle’s energy must be a whole-number multiple
Measurement always changes a particle’s mass
concepts.whyZh: Δx · Δp ≥ ħ/2，这是量子系统本身的性质，不只是仪器误差。
concepts.whyEn: Δx · Δp ≥ ħ/2 is a property of quantum systems, not just instrument error.

concepts.zh: 热力学第二定律的一种表述是？
concepts.en: One statement of the second law of thermodynamics is…
concepts.answerZh: 孤立系统的熵不会减少
concepts.answerEn: The entropy of an isolated system never decreases
wrongZh: 热量能自发地从低温物体传向高温物体
第一类永动机可以制成
wrongEn: Heat flows spontaneously from cold to hot
A perpetual-motion machine of the first kind can be built
concepts.whyZh: 其余三项分别违反能量守恒、克劳修斯表述和热力学第一定律。
concepts.whyEn: The other three break energy conservation, the Clausius statement and the first law.

concepts.zh: 法拉第电磁感应定律说明，感应电动势的大小与什么成正比？
concepts.en: Faraday’s law says the induced emf is proportional to…
concepts.answerEn: The rate of change of magnetic flux
concepts.whyZh: ε = −dΦ/dt：磁通量再大，只要不变化就没有感应电动势。
concepts.whyEn: ε = −dΦ/dt: however large the flux, a constant flux induces no emf.

concepts.zh: 麦克斯韦方程组预言了什么？
concepts.en: What did Maxwell’s equations predict?
concepts.answerZh: 电磁波的存在，且其真空中的速度等于光速
concepts.answerEn: Electromagnetic waves, travelling at the speed of light in vacuum
wrongEn: Charge can be divided without limit
concepts.whyZh: 由方程算出的波速 1/√(μ₀ε₀) 恰好等于光速，说明光是电磁波。
concepts.whyEn: The wave speed 1/√(μ₀ε₀) equals the speed of light, so light is an electromagnetic wave.

concepts.zh: 量子隧穿指的是？
concepts.en: Quantum tunnelling means…
concepts.answerZh: 粒子有一定概率穿过经典上无法越过的势垒
concepts.answerEn: A particle can pass a barrier it could not cross classically
wrongZh: 粒子自发获得足够能量越过势垒
wrongEn: The particle is always fully reflected
The particle spontaneously gains enough energy to climb over
The particle exceeds the speed of light
concepts.whyZh: 波函数在势垒内指数衰减但不为零，所以有透射概率。
concepts.whyEn: The wave function decays exponentially inside the barrier but is not zero, so there is a transmission probability.

concepts.zh: 德布罗意假说认为？
concepts.en: The de Broglie hypothesis says…
concepts.answerZh: 实物粒子也具有波动性
concepts.answerEn: Matter particles also behave as waves
wrongZh: 物质波的波长与动量无关
wrongEn: Matter-wave wavelength is independent of momentum
concepts.whyZh: 波长 λ = h/p，电子衍射实验证实了这一点。
concepts.whyEn: The wavelength is λ = h/p, confirmed by electron diffraction.

concepts.zh: 理想气体的温度在微观上反映了什么？
concepts.en: Microscopically, the temperature of an ideal gas reflects…
concepts.answerEn: The mean translational kinetic energy of the molecules
wrongEn: The total mass of the molecules
concepts.whyZh: ⟨E⟩ = (3/2) k_B T，温度只与平均平动动能有关。
concepts.whyEn: ⟨E⟩ = (3/2) k_B T, so temperature depends only on the mean translational kinetic energy.
